description: Mathnasium is a math-only learning-center franchise: children attend centers typically twice a week for ~60-minute sessions using the Mathnasium education method. The franchisor, Mathnasium Franchisor LLC of Los Angeles, California (a Delaware LLC organized July 2024, majority owned via Roark Capital since 2021), began offering franchises in September 2024; the brand has been franchised since 2003. Per the 2026 FDD, the franchise fee is $49,000, total initial investment ranges from $127,316 to $165,846, royalties are 10% of gross receipts ($650/mo base royalty; $1,500/mo minimum from month 24) plus $250+2% marketing and $1,000/mo digital/local marketing, and territories are designated with protective rights but not exclusive. Item 19 (2025): 914 reporting centers averaged $384,874 in gross receipts with average operating profit of $117,000 (30.4%). The US system grew from 972 outlets at end-2023 to 1,047 at end-2025.
territoryDescription: Designated territory with protective rights but NOT exclusive: at least 2,500 children ages 5-19 at signing; franchisor reserves broad rights (other channels, schools/distance learning, company centers outside territory, competing systems); boundaries may be reconfigured; center must sit inside the territory.
item12_detail: designated territory with protective rights but NOT exclusive (Item 12, p.38)
item20_reconciliation: FDD Item 20 Table No. 1 (p.58): 1,047 US outlets as of 12/31/2025 (1,043 franchised + 4 company-owned). The 15 pins below are FEATURED locations — real operational franchisees from FDD Exhibit A-1 — not a complete map of all outlets.

veteran_discount.value: 25% off initial franchise fee (VetFran, qualifying veterans/active-duty)

educator_discount.value: 25% off initial franchise fee (credentialed teachers/administrators, education-degree graduates per eligibility rules)

royalty_terms.value: 10% of monthly Gross Receipts; from the 24th month of operation, the greater of 10% or $1,500/month

base_royalty.value: $650/month beginning 6 months after signing (first Center); franchisees currently pay a single base royalty across all centers operated

digital_local_marketing_fee.value: Minimum $1,000/month, credited against local marketing spend

late_interest.value: 10% per annum or highest permitted rate

transferee_training_fee.value: $3,000 (up to 2 people, transferee of existing operating center)

renewal_fee.value: $7,000, payable lump sum or 14 monthly installments of $500

fee_increase_rule.value: Fixed-dollar fees may increase annually by greater of 3.0% or CPI-Service Group; no CPI adjustment to percentage royalty (10%) or marketing (2%)

royalty_rebate_acquisition.value: 100% monthly royalty rebate up to $1,500/mo ($13,500 max) for 9 months when existing franchisee acquires center with <=$176,306 trailing gross receipts; tiered rebate to $278,021; annual policy review

territory_model.value: Designated territory with protective rights; NOT exclusive — franchisor reserves broad rights (other channels, schools/distance learning, company centers outside territory, competing systems)

territory_size_rule.value: Territory believed to contain at least 2,500 children ages 5-19 at signing

territory_reconfiguration.value: Franchisor may reconfigure boundaries (target-market fit, relocation, boundary/demographic changes, manual-specified events)

location_restriction.value: Center must be inside territory; no teaching outside accepted location (incl. students' homes) without annual-renewal written approval; relocation only within territory with consent

owner_participation.value: Owner must personally participate and devote sufficient time; passive investment not sought; Center Director required (full-time during business hours); >=2 adults present when children in Center

owner_guarantee.value: All entity owners must personally guarantee franchise obligations

renewal_terms.value: Successor franchise agreements for additional 5-year terms if in good standing; renewal fee $7,000

dispute_resolution.value: Mediation/arbitration/litigation in Los Angeles County, California (state-required special-risk disclosure)

minimum_sales_performance.value: Minimum sales performance levels required; failure may cause loss of territorial rights, termination, loss of investment

mandatory_minimum_payments.value: Royalty payments owed regardless of sales levels
